title: Waste collected before contractor arrival has no supported later-handover operation
actual: The screen requires weighing/recording each category per area at collection, and recording the consignment at later contractor handover. POST permits collection-only rows, but the bundle/reference/search expose only POST/GET /infection/waste. A confirmed synthetic collection waste_id=1 (0.25kg NonRisk,2026-11-05) remains vendor_id/manifest/disposal null and handed_over_kg=0. There is no supported operation to attach later handover to this existing collection. PUT /infection/waste/1 returns404 NOT_FOUND. A new collection POST would count the same weight again, so frontend does not offer that workaround.
expected: Per waste_log_ops rule:889ac3e40b ('Weigh each category’s bags per area at collection; record the contractor’s consignment note at handover'), support an idempotent later-handover operation referencing existing waste IDs (or a documented batch/partial handover workflow) without recording collection weight again. Specify permission, validation, conflict/recovery semantics and totals, then update bundles/types/workflow/test plan. If the intended workflow differs, document how to satisfy both collection-time recording and later consignment safely.
steps:
1. As demo.ops record one visibly synthetic collection-only batch at collection time (actual saved ID1; no real waste).
2. GET /infection/waste?date_from=2026-11-05&date_to=2026-11-05&limit=5000: one0.25kg NonRisk row, handed_over_kg0.
3. At contractor handover, seek an operation to add vendor/manifest/disposal to this same collection: search_api('waste handover') and screen bundle provide only GET/POSTcollection; get_endpoint PUT /infection/waste/{waste_id} says no endpoint.
4. Sandbox PUT /infection/waste/1 with vendor_id2, synthetic manifest and disposalRecycling returns404. Reread preserves original null handover fields. Do not POST the same weight again.
